mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% for two consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration, triggering earnings slowdown expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals early economic contraction, reducing corporate profit expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strengthening consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.5% for three months signals inflation persistence, delaying monetary policy easing and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating industrial production above 102.5 signals strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 102.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
